label: Sixth-edition aphorisms
title: Aphorism § 83
text:
§ 83



 This individualizing examination of a case of disease, for which I
          shall only give in this place general directions, of which the practitioner will bear in
          mind only what is applicable for each individual case, demands of the physician nothing
          but freedom from prejudice and sound senses, attention in observing and fidelity in
          tracing the picture of the disease.
